بِلَذِيْذُ مُنَاجَاتِهِمْ۔ o allah! indeed i have faith in the sanctity of your prophet in his absence, just as i have faith in his presence. and i know that verily your prophet and your vicegerents are alive and obtain sustenance near you, they witness my position, and hear my speech, and return my salaam, and indeed you have concealed their speech from me, and have opened the door of my understanding through the taste of whispering supplications with them. فَاِنِّیْ اَسْتَاذِنُكَ يَارَبِّ اَوَّلَا، وَاَسْتَاذِنُ رَسُوْلَكَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهٖ ثَانِيًا، وَاَسْتَاذِنُ خَلِيْفَتَكَ الْاِمَامَ الْمَفْرُوْضَ عَلَيَّ طَاعَتُهٗ، فِی الدُّخُوْلِ فِیْ سَاعَتِیْ هٰذِهٖ اِلٰی بَیْتِهٖ، وَاَسْتَاذِنُ مَلَائِكَتَكَ الْمُوَكَّلِیْنَ بِهٰذِهِ الْقِطْعَۃِ الْمُبَارَكَۃِ الْمُطِیْعَۃِ السَّامِعَۃِ۔ and indeed i firstly seek permission from you, o lord; and secondly i seek permission from your prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, and i seek permission from your vicegerent, the imam whose obedience is obligatory on me, to enter his house in this moment, and i seek permission from your angels who are appointed by you to serve this holy place, they are obedient and hearing. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمْ اَیُّهَا الْمَلَائِكَۃُ الْمُوَكَّلُوْنَ بِهٰذَا الْمَشْهَدِ الشَّرِیْفِ الْمُبَارَكِ وَرَحْمَۃُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهٗ، بِاِذْنِ اللهِ، وَاِذْنِ رَسُوْلِهٖ، وَاِذْنِ خُلَفَائِهٖ، وَاِذْنِ هٰذَا الْاِمَامِ، وَاِذْنِكُمْ صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ عَلَیْكُمْ اَجْمَعِیْنَ۔ peace be upon you, o angels who are appointed on this holy and noble shrine; may allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you. with the permission of allah, and the permission of his prophet, and the permission of his vicegerents, and with the permission of this imam, and with your permission (peace be upon all of you). اَدْخُلُ اِلٰی هٰذَا الْبَیْتِ مُتَقَرِّبًا اِلَی اللهِ بِاللهِ وَرَسُوْلِهٖ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِهِ الطَّاهِرِیْنَ، فَكُوْنُوْا مَلَائِكَۃَ اللهِ اَعْوَانِیْ، وَكُوْنُوْا اَنْصَارِیْ، حَتّٰی اَدْخُلَ هٰذَا الْبَیْتِ، وَاَدْعُوَ اللهَ بِفُنُوْنِ الدَّعَوَاتِ، وَاَعْتَرَفَ لِلهِ بِالْعُبُوْدِیَّۃِ، وَلِهٰذَا الْاِمَامِ وَاٰبَائِهٖ صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ عَلَیْهِمْ بِالطَّاعَۃِ۔ i enter this house seeking the nearness of allah through allah and his prophet, mohammad and his holy progeny, thus o angels of allah, be my helpers, and be my supporters, so that i enter this house, and i call allah through various supplications, and i accept my servitude for allah, and my obedience for this imam and his ancestors, peace be upon them. then enter with your right foot and go towards the lower area of the holy vault while saying… phir pehle daahena qadam (right leg) badhaaye aur daakhil ho aur kahe… پھر پیلے داہنا قدم بڑھائیں اور داخل ہوں اور کہیں۔۔۔ بِسْمِ اللهِ وَبِاللهِ، وَفِيْ سَبِيْلِ اللهِ، وَعَلٰى مِلَّةِ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهٖ۔ اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِیْكَ لَهٗ، وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهٗ وَرَسُوْلُهٗ۔ in the name of allah and with the help of allah, and upon the nation of allah’s messenger, peace be upon him and his progeny, i bear witness that there is no god save allah alone and he has not partner for himself, and i bear witness that mohammad is his slave and his prophet. thereafter, say takbeer (allah o akbar), tahmeed (alhamdolillah), tasbeeh (subhanallah) and tahleel (la ilaha ilallah) until you reach the actual place of the holy vault, then stand facing the qibla and say… phir takbeer (allaho akbar), tehreer (alhamdolillah) aur tasbeeh (subhanallah) o tehleel (la ilaha ilallah) kare aur jab us muqaddas makaan par pohonch jaaye to qibla rukh khade ho kar kahe… پھر تکبیر تمجید اور تسبیح و تہلیل کریں اور جب اس مقدس مکان پر متمقر ہو جائیں تو قبلہ رخ کھڑے ہو کر کہیں۔۔۔ سَلَامُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهٗ وَتَحِیَّاتُهٗ وَصَلَوَاتُهٗ عَلٰی مَوْلَایَ صَاحِبِ الزَّمَانِ، صَاحِبِ الضِّیَائِ وَالنُّوْرِ، وَالدِّیْنِ الْمَاثُوْرِ، وَلِلِّوَائِ الْمَشْهُوْرِ، وَالْكِتَابِ الْمَنْشُوْرِ، وَصَاحِبِ الدُّهُوْرِ وَالْعُصُوْرِ، وَخَلَفِ الْحَسَنِ، اَلْاِمَامِ الْمُؤْتَمَنِ، وَالْقَائِمِ الْمُعْتَمَدِ، وَالمَنْصُوْرِ الْمُؤَیَّدِ، وَالْكَهْفِ وَالْعَضُدِ عِمَادِ الْاِسْلَامِ، وَرُكْنِ الْاَنَامِ، وَمِفْتَاحِ الْكَلَامِ، وَ وَلِیِّ الْاَحْكَامِ، وَشَمْسِ الظَّلَامِ، وَبَدْرِ التِّمَامِ، وَنَضْرَۃِ الْاَیَّامِ وَصَاحِبِ الْصَّمْصَامِ، وَفَلَّاقِ الْهَامِ، وَالْبَحْرِ الْقَمْقَامِ، وَالسَّیِّدِ الْهُمَامِ، وَحُجَّۃِ الْخِصَامِ، وَبَابِ الْمَقَامِ لِیَوْمِ الْقِیَامِ۔ allah’s peace and his blessings and his greetings and his mercy be upon my master, the master of time, the master of brightness and light, and the true religion, and the evident flag, and the published book, and the master of the times and the eras, and the noble successor, and the authentic imam, and the reliable riser, the helped and the supported, the shelter and the promoter, the foundation of islam, the pillar of the people, the key of speech, the guardian of commands, the illuminator in the darkness, the full moon, the freshness of the days, the owner of sharp sword, the striker of target, the sea brimming with water, the merciful sayyid, the proof against the enemies, the divine door on the day of resurrection. وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَی مُفَرِّجِ الْكُرُبَاتِ، وَخَوَّاضِ الْغَمَرَاتِ، وَمُنَفِّسِ الْحَسَرَاتِ، وَبَقِیَّۃِ اللهِ فِیْ اَرْضِهٖ، وَصَاحِبِ فَرْضِهٖ، وَحُجَّتِهٖ عَلٰی خَلْقِهٖ، وَعَیْبَۃِ عِلْمِهٖ، وَمَوْضِعِ صِدْقِهٖ، وَالْمُنْتَهٰی اِلَیْهِ مَوَارِیْثُ الْاَنْبِیَائِ، وَلَدَیْهِ مَوْجُوْدٌ اٰثَارُ الْاَوْصِیَائِ، وَحُجَّۃِ اللهِ، وَابْنِ رَسُوْلِهٖ، وَالْقَیِّمِ مَقَامَهٗ، وَ وَلِیِّ اَمْرِ اللهِ، وَرَحْمَۃُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهٗ۔ and peace be upon them resolver of difficulties, the reliever of hardships, the remover of sorrows, the remainder of allah on his earth, the owner of obligatory commands, his argument upon his creation, the bearer of his knowledge, the place of his truth, the inheritor of the fortunes of the prophets, and the imprints of the successors is available near him, the argument of allah, the son of his prophet, who stands in his place, the guardian of allah’s affairs, peace and blessing be upon him. اَللّٰهُمَّ كَمَا انْتَجَبْتَهٗ لِعَلْمِكَ، وَاصْطَفَیْتَهٗ لِحُكْمِكَ، وَخَصَصْتَهٗ بِمَعْرِفَتِكَ، وَجَلَّلْتَهٗ بِكَرَامَتِكَ، وَغَشَّیْتَهٗ بِرَحْمَتِكَ، وَرَبَّیْتَهٗ بِنِعْمَتِكَ، وَغَذَّیْتَهٗ بِحِكْمَتِكَ، وَاخْتَرْتَهٗ لِنَفْسِكَ، وَاجْتَبَیْتَهٗ لِبَاسِكَ، وَارْتَضَیْتَهٗ لِقُدْسِكَ، وَجَعَلْتَهٗ هَادِیًا لِمَنْ شَئْتَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، وَدَیَّانَ الدِّیْنِ بِعَدْلِكَ، وَفَصْلَ الْقَضَایَا بَیْنَ عِبَادِكَ۔ o allah! just like you have selected him for your knowledge, and have chosen him for your wisdom, and have specified your cognizance for him, and have glorified him with your dignity, and have covered him with your mercy, and have nourished him with your bounties, and have fed him with your wisdom, and have created him for yourself, and have chosen him for your power, and have preferred him for your sanctity, and have made him your guide for those whom you wish from you creation, and the ruler of the religion with your justice, and the decider of judgments between your servants. وَ وَعَدْتَهٗ اَنْ تَجْمَعَ بِهِ الْكَلِمَ، وَتُفَرِّجَ بِهٖ عَنِ الْاُمَمِ، وَتُنِیْرَ بِعَدْلِهِ الظُّلَمَ، وَتُطْفِیَٔ بِهٖ نِیْرَانَ الظُّلْمِ، وَتَقْمَعَ بِهٖ حَرَّالْكُفْرِ وَاٰثَارَهٗ، وَتَطَهِّرَ بِهٖ بِلَادَكَ، وَتَشْفِیَ بِهٖ صُدُوْرَ عِبَادِكَ، وَتَجْمَعَ بِهِ الْمَمَالِكَ كُلَّهَا، قَرِیْبَهَا وَبَعِیْدَهَا، عَذِیْزَهَا وَذَلِیْلَهَا، شَرْقَهَا وَغَرْبَهَا، سَهْلَهَا وَجَبَلَهَا، صَبَاهَا وَدُبُوْرَهَا، شِمَالَهَا وَجُنُوْبَهَا، وَبَرَّهَا وَبَحْرَهَا، حُزُوْنَهَا وَ وُعُوْرَهَا، یَمْلَاُهَا قِسْطًا وَعَدْلًا، كَمَا مُلِئَتْ ظُلْمًا وَجَوْرًا۔ and you have promised him to unify all the perspectives through him, and to deliver the nations through him, and to illuminate the darkness through him, and to put of the fire of oppression through him, and to remove the heart of infidelity and its signs through him, and to purify your cities through him, and to cure the hearts of your servants through him, and to gather all the realms through him, the near ones and the far away ones, the reputed ones and the disgraced ones, from the east and the west, the plains and the mountains, the graze lands and the deserts, from the north and the south, from the land and the sea, from the plateaus and the terrains, to fill them with justice, just like they were filled with oppression and tyranny. تُمَكِّنَ لَهٗ فِیْهَا، وَتُنْجِزَ بِهٖ وَعْدَالْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ، حَتّٰی لَا یُشْرَكَ بِكَ شَیْئًا، وَحَتّٰی لَا یَبْقٰی حَقٌّ اِلَّا ظَهَرَ، وَلَا عَدْلٌ اِلَّا زَهَرَ، وَحَتّٰی لَا یَسْتَخْفِیَ بِشَیْءٍ مِنَ الْحَقِّ مَخَافَۃَ اَحَدٍ مِّنَ الْخَلْقِ۔ and also promised him to strengthen him in it, and to fulfil the promises made to the believers, until no partner is ascribed with you, and until no truth remains without being prevailed, and no justice remains without being prominent, and until nothing from truth and righteousness is concealed from the people due to the fear of anyone. اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَیْهِ صَلَاۃً تَظْهِرُ بِهَا حُجَّتَهٗ، وَتُوْضِحُ بِهَا بَهْجَتَهٗ، وَتَرْفَعُ بِهَا دَرَجَتَهٗ، وَتُؤَیِّدُ بِهَا سُلْطَانَهٗ، وَتُعَظِّمُ بِهَا بُرْهَانَهٗ، وَتُشَرِّفُ بِهَا مَكَانَهٗ، وَتُعْلِیْ بِهَا بُنْیَانَهٗ، تُعِزُّ بِهَا نَصْرَهٗ، وَتَرْفَعُ بِهَا قَدْرَهٗ، بِهَا ذِكْرَهٗ، وَتُظْهِرُ بِهَا كَلِمَتَهٗ، وَتُكَثِّرُ بِهَا نُصْرَتَهٗ، وَتُعِزُّ بِهَا دَعْوَتَهٗ، وَتُزِیْدُهٗ بِهَا اِكْرَامًا، وَتَجْعَلُهٗ لِلْمُتَّقِیْنَ اِمَامًا، وَتُبَلِّغُهُ فِیْ هٰذَا الْمَكَانِ مِثْلَ هٰذَا الْاَوَانِ، وَفِیْ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ مِنَّا تَحِیَّۃً وَسَلَامًا، لَا یَبْلٰی جَدِیْدُهٗ (وَلَا یَفْنٰی عَدِیْدُهٗ)۔ o allah! bless him with a blessing through which his argument prevails, and his freshness becomes evident, and his position elevates, and his dominion is promoted, and his proof is honoured, and his position is respected, and his foundations are uplifted, and his support is dignified, and his value is raised, and his memory becomes apparent, and his word becomes evident, and his support is exceeded, and his invitation is glorified, and through which you exceed his honour, and you make him the imam of the pious, and deliver our greetings to him from this place and in this moment and in all place, such that its freshness doesn’t vanish, and its benefits do not end. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا بَقِیَّۃَ اللهِ فِیْ اَرْضِهٖ وَبِلَادِهٖ، وَحُجَّتَهٗ عَلٰی عِبَادِهٖ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا خَلَفَ السَّلَفِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا صَاحِبَ الشَّرَفِ، اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا حُجَّۃَ الْمَعْبُوْدِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا كَلِمَۃَ الْمَحْمُوْدِ۔ peace be upon you, o remainder of allah on his earth and his cities, and his argument on his creations, peace be upon you o successor of the righteous predecessors, peace be upon you o owner of dignity, peace be upon you o proof of the lord, peace be upon you o word of the praised. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا شَمْسَ الشُّمُوْسِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا مَهْدِیَّ الْاَرْضِ وَعَیْنَ الْفَرْضِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا مَوْلَایَ یَا صَاحِبَ الزَّمَانِ وَالْعَالِیَ الشَّانِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا خَاتَمَ الْاَوْصِیَائِ وَابْنَ الْاَنْبِیَائِ۔ peace be upon you o sun of the suns, peace be upon you o guided among the people of earth and the spring of religion, peace be upon you o my master, o master of the time, o master of high value, peace be upon you o seal of successors, and the son of the prophets. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا مُعِزَّ الْاَوْلِیَائِ وُمُذِلَّ الْاَعْدَائِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا لاْاِمَامُ الْفَرِیْدُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْاِمَامُ الْمُنْتَظَرُ وَالْحَقُّ الْمُشْتَهَرُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْاِمَامُ الْوَلِیُّ الْمُجْتَبٰی وَالْحَقُّ الْمُشْتَهٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْاِمَامُ الْمُرْتَجٰی لِاِزَالَۃِ الْجَوْرِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ۔ peace be upon you o honourer of the friends and the disgracer of the enemies, peace be upon you o secluded imam, peace be upon you o anticipated imam and the widespread truth, peace be upon you o imam, the guardian, the chosen one, the desirable truth. peace be upon you o imam who is selected for the removal of oppression and transgression, peace be upon you o imam, the destroyer of the lecherous and the tyrant. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْاَمَامُ الْمُبِیْدُ لِاَهْلِ الْفُسُوْقِ وَالطُّغْیَانِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْاِمَامَ الْهَادِمُ لِبُنْیَانِ الشِّرْكِ وَالنِّفَاقِ، وَالْحَاصِدْ فُرُوْعَ الْغَیِّ وَالشَّقَاقِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْمُدَّخَرُ لِتَجْدِیْدِ الْفَرَائِضِ وَالسُّنَنِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا طَامِسَ اٰثَارِ الزَّیْغِ وَالْاَهْوَائِ، وَقَاطِعَ حَبَائِلِ الْكِذْبِ وَالْفِتَنِ وَالْاِفْتِرَائِ۔ peace be upon you o imam, the demolisher of the foundations of polytheism and hypocrisy, who will cut down the branches of misguidance and misfortunes, peace be upon you o he who is treasured for refreshing the obligations and traditions, peace be upon you o destroyer of the signs of deviation and lusts, who will cut the ropes of falsehood, temptations and accusations. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْمُؤَمَّلُ لِاِحْیَائِ الدُّوْلَۃِ الشَّرِیْفَۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا جَامِعَ الْكَلِمَۃِ عَلَی التَّقْوٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا بَابَ اللهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا ثَارَ اللهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا مُحْیِیْ مَعَالِمِ الدِّیْنِ وَاَهْلِهٖ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا قَاصِمَ شَوْكَۃِ الْمُعْتَدِیْنَ۔ peace be upon you o he who hopes for the revival of the noble nation. peace be upon you o unifier of the word on piety, peace be upon you o divine doorway, peace be upon you o vengeance of allah, peace be upon you o reviver of the signs of religion and the religious men, peace be upon you o destroyer of the glory of the transgressors. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا وَجْهَ اللهِ الَّذِیْ لَا یَهْلَكُ وَلَا یَبْلٰی اِلٰی یَوْمِ الدِّیْنِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا السَّبَبُ الْمُتَّصِلُ بَیْنَ الْاَرْضِ وَالسَّمَائِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا صَاحِبَ الْفَتْحِ وَنَاشِرَ رَاٰیَۃِ الْهُدٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا مُؤَلِّفَ شَمْلِ الصَّلَاحِ وَالرِّضَا۔ peace be upon you o face of allah, who cannot be destroyed and cannot grow old until the day of judgment, peace be upon you o cause of connection between the earth and the heaven, peace be upon you o owner of the key and the bearer of the flag of guidance, peace be upon you o gatherer of well-being and satisfaction. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا طَالِبَ ثَارِ الْاَنْبِیَائِ وَاَبْنَائِ الْاَنْبِیَائِ، وَالثَّائِرَ بِدَمِ الْمَقْتُوْلِ بِكَرْبَلَائَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْمَنْصُوْرُ عَلٰی مَنِ اَعْتَدٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْمُنْتَظَرُ الْمُجَابُ اِذَا دَعٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا بَقِیَّۃَ الْخَلَائِفِ، اَلْبَرُّ التَّقِیُّ، اَلْبَاقِیْ لِاِزَالَۃِ الْجَوْرِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ۔ peace be upon you o seeker of the vengeance of the prophets and the son of the prophets, and the avenger of the blood of karbala s martyr, peace be upon you o supported one against the tyrant, peace be upon you o anticipated one whose supplication is accepted, peace be upon you o remainder of the successors, the noble and the pious, the remainder for the removal of oppressions and transgression. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ مُحَمَّدِ الْمُصْطَفٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ عَلِیِّ الْمُرْتَضٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ فَاطِمَۃَ الزَّهْرَائِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ خَدِیْجَۃَ الْكُبْرٰی، وَابْنَ السَّادَۃِ الْمُقَرَّبِیْنَ وَالْقَادَۃِ الْمُتَّقِیْنَ۔ peace be upon you o son of mohammad, the chosen one, peace be upon you o son of ali, the content one, peace be upon you o son of lady fatima zahra, peace be upon you o son of lady khadijatul kubra, and the son of the chiefs who are close to allah’s threshold and the pious leaders. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ النُّجَبَائِ الْاَكْرَمِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْاَصْفِیَائِ الْمُهَذَّبِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْهُدَاۃِ الْمَهْدِیِّیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ خِیَرَۃِ الْخِیَرِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ سَادَۃِ الْبَشَرِ۔ peace be upon you o son of the honourable noblemen, peace be upon you o son of the pure chosen ones, peace be upon you o son of the guided guides, peace be upon you o son of the best of all the bests, peace be upon you o son of the leaders of the humans. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْغَطَارِفَۃِ الْاَكْرَمِیْنَ، وَالْاَطَائِبِ الْمَطَهَّرِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْبَرَرَۃِ الْمُنْتَجَبِیْنَ، وَالْخَضَارِمَۃِ الْاَنْجَبِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْحُجَجِ الْمُنِیْرَۃِ، وَالسُّرُجِ الْمُضِیْئَۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الشُّهُبِ الثَاقِبَۃَ۔ peace be upon you o son of the honourable masters, and the purified men, peace be upon you o son of the chosen noblemen, and the honourable bestowers, peace be upon you o son of the luminescent proofs, and the glowing lamps, peace be upon you o son of the shining stars. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ قَوَاعِدِ الْعِلْمِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ مَعَادِنِ الْحِلْمِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْكَوَاكِبِ الزَّاهِرَۃِ، وَالنُّجُوْمِ الْبَاهِرَۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الشُّمُوْسِ الطَّالِعَۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْاَقْمَارِ السَّاطِعَۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ السُّبُلِ الْوَاضِحَۃِ، وَالْاَعْلَامِ اللّٰائِحَۃِ۔ peace be upon you o son of the pillars of knowledge, peace be upon you o son of the mines of endurance, peace be upon you o son of the bright planets, and the beautiful stars, peace be upon you o son of the risen suns, peace be upon you o sons of the glowing moons, peace be upon you o sons of the evident paths, and the apparent signs. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ السُّنَنِ الْمَشْهُوْرَۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْمَعَالِمِ الْمَاثُوْرَۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الشَّوَاهِدِ الْمَشْهُوْدَۃِ، وَالْمُعْجِزَاتِ الْمَوْجُوْدَۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الصِّرَاطِ الْمُسْتَقِیْمِ، وَالنَّبَاِ الْعَظِیْمِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْآیَاتِ الْبَیِّنَاتِ، وَالدَّلَائِلِ الظَّاهِرَاتِ۔ peace be upon you o son of the famous traditions, peace be upon you o son of the remnant signs, peace be upon you o son of the witnessed witnesses, and the present miracles, peace be upon you o son of the straight path, and the great news, peace be upon you o son of the clear signs, and the evident proofs. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْبَرَاهِیْنِ الْوَاضِحَاتِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْحُجَجِ الْبَالِغَاتِ، وَالنِّعَمِ السَّابِغَاتِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ طٰهٰ وَالْمُحْكَمَاتِ، وَیٰسٓ وَالذَّارِیَاتِ، وَالطُّوْرِ وَالْعَادِیَاتِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ مَنْ دَنٰی فَتَدَلّٰی فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَیْنِ اَوْ اَدْنٰی، وَاقْتَرَبَ مِنَ الْعَلِیِّ الْاَعْلٰی۔ peace be upon you o son of the obvious arguments, peace be upon you o son of effective evidences, and the abundant bounties, peace be upon you o son of taha and the precise verse, and yaseen and zaariyaat, and toor and wal-aadiyaat, peace be upon you o son of him who drew near and came down till he was at two bow s length or nearer, and neared the sublime, the supreme. لَیْتَ شِعْرِیْ اَیْنَ اسْتَقَرَّتْ بِكَ النَّوٰی، اَوْ اَنْتَ بِوَادِیْ طُوٰی، وَزِیْزٌ عَلَیَّ اَنْ اَرَی الْخَلْقَ وَلَا تُرٰی، وَلَایُسْمَعُ لَكَ حَسِیْسٌ وَلَا نَجْوٰی، عَزِیْزٌ عَلَیَّ اَنْ یُرَی الْخَلْقُ وَلَا تُرٰی، عَزِیْزٌ اَنْ تُحِیْطَ بِكَ الْاَعْدَائُ۔ if i but knew the destination of your perfect journey, are you in a well-guarded concealed valley, it breaks my heart when i look at all that is created but cannot see you, nor hear a whisper about your whereabouts nor any secret communication, it breaks my heart that the creations can be seen but you cannot be seen, it is disheartening for me to know that you are surrounded by the enemies. بِنَفْسِیْ اَنْتَ مِنْ مُغَیَّبٍ مَا غَابَ عَنَّا، بِنَفْسِیْ اَنْتَ مِنْ نَازِحٍ مَانَزَحَ عَنَّا وَنَحْنُ نَقُوْلُ۔ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِیْنَ، وَصَلَّی اللهُ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِهٖ اَجْمَعِیْنَ۔ i eagerly long for the hidden who is not actually hidden from us, i eagerly long for you who has departed but is not far from us, and we say, praise be to allah, the lord of the worlds, and peace be upon mohammad and his entire progeny. now raise your hands and recite… iske baad phir apne haatho’n ko baland kare aur kahe… اس کے بعد پھر اپنے ہاتھوں کو بلند کریں اور کہیں۔۔۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ كَاشِفُ الْكُرَبِ اَالْبَلْوٰی، وَاِلَیْكَ نَشْكُوْ غَیْبَۃَ اِمَامِنَا، وَابْنِ بِنْتِ نَبِیِّنَا۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ فَامْلَا بِهِ الْاَرْضَ عَدْلَا وَقِسْطًا، كَمَا مُلِئَتْ ظُلْمًا وَّجَوْرَا۔ o allah! indeed you are the disperser of sorrows and hardships, and to you we complain regarding the occultation of our imams, and the son of prophet’s daughter. o allah! fill the earth with justice like it was filled with oppression and tyranny. اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاَهْلِ بَیْتِهٖ، وَاَرِنَا سَیِّدَنَا وَصَاحِبَنَا وَاِمَامَنَا وَمَوْلَانَا صَاحِبَ الزَّمَانِ، وَمَلْجَأَ اَهْلِ عَصْرِنَا، وَمَنْجَا اَهْلِ دَهْرِنَا، ظَاهِرَالْمَقَالَۃِ، وَاضِحَ الدَّلَالَۃِ، هَادِیًا مِنَ الضَّلَالَۃِ، مُنْقِذًا مِنَ الْجَهَالَۃِ، وَاَظْهِرْ مَعَالِمَهٗ، وَثَبِّتْ قَوَاعِدَهٗ وَاَعِزَّ نَصْرَهٗ، وَاَطِلْ عُمْرَهٗ، وَاَبْسِطْ جَاهَدُ، وَاَحْیِ اَمْرَهٗ، وَاَظْهِرْ نُوْرَهٗ، وَقَرِّبْ بُعْدَهٗ، وَاَنْجِزْ وَعْدَهٗ، وَاَوْفِ عَهْدَهٗ۔ o allah! bless mohammad and his household, and show us our leader, our owner, our imam, and our master, the master of time, the shelter of our age, the deliverer of our time, with evident speech and clear proofs, a guide from the misguidance, a rescuer from ignorance, and make his signs apparent, and strengthen his pillars, and dignify his support, and elongate his life, and extend his position, and revive his affair, and display his light, and bring his distance near, and fulfil his promises, and accomplish his oaths. وَزَیِّنِ الْاَرْضَ بِطُوْلِ بَقَائِهٖ، وَدَوَامِ مُلْكِهٖ، وَعُلُوِّ ارْتِقَائِهٖ، وَارْتِفَاعِهٖ، وَاَنِرْ مَشَاهِدَهٗ، وَثَبِّتْ قَوَاعِدَهٗ، وَعَظِّمْ بُرْهَانَهٗ، وَاَمِدْ سُلْطَانَهٗ، وَاَعْلِ مَكَانَهٗ، وَقَوِّ اَرْكَانَهٗ، وَاَرِنَا وَجْهَهٗ، وَاَوْضِحْ بَهْجَتَهٗ، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهٗ، وَاَظْهِرْ كَلِمَتَهٗ، وَاَعِزَّ دَعْوَتَهٗ، وَاَعْطِهِ سُؤْلَهٗ، بَلِّغْهُ یَا رَبِّ مَامُوْلَهٗ، وَشَرِّفْ مَقَامَهٗ، وَعَظِّمْ اِكْرَامَهٗ۔ and beautify the earth with his extensive existence, and his eternal kingdom, and his high elevation and rise, and brighten the places of his existence, and strengthen his pillars, and dignify his arguments, and extend his dominion, and elevate his position, and strengthen his pillars, and show us his face, and display his happiness, and rise his status, and succeed his word, and glorify his invitation, and fulfil his desires, and deliver to him all that he hopes for, o lord, and honour his position, greaten his respect. وَاَعِزَّبِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ، وَاَحْیِ بِهٖ سُنَنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ، وَاَذِلَّ بِهِ الْمُنَافِقِیْنَ، وَاَهْلِكْ بِهِ الْجَبَّارِیْنَ، وَاكْفِهٖ بَغْیَ الْحَاسِدِیْنَ، وَاَعِذْهُ مِنْ شَرِّ الْكَائِدِیْنَ، وَازْجُرْ عَنْهُ اِرَادَۃَ الظَّالِمِیْنَ، وَاَیِّدْهُ بِجُنُوْدٍ مِّنَ الْمَلَائِكَۃِ مُسَوِّمِیْنَ، وَسَلِّطْهُ عَلٰی اَعْدَائِ دِیْنِكَ اَجْمَعِیْنَ۔ and dignify the believers through him, and revive the traditions of the prophets through him, and humiliate the hypocrites through him, and destroy the tyrants, and suffice him against the oppression of the jealous men, and provide him shelter from the evil of the schemers, and keep the wicked intentions of the transgressors from him, and support him with an army of the known angels. وَاَقْصِمْ بِهٖ كُلَّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِیْدٍ، وَاَخْمِدْ بِسَیْفِهٖ كُلَّ نَارٍ وَقَیْدٍ، وَاَنْفِذْ حُكْمَهٗ فِیْ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ، وَاَقِمْ بِسُلْطَانِهٖ كُلَّ سُلْطَانٍ، وَاَقْمِعْ بِهٖ عَبَدَۃَ الْاَوْثَانِ، وَشَرَّفْ بِهٖ اَهْلَ الْقُرْآنِ وَالْاِیْمَانِ، وَاَظْهِرْهُ عَلٰی كُلِّ الْاَدْیَانِ، وَاَكْبِتْ مَنْ عَادَاهُ، وَاَذِلَّ مَنْ نَاوَاهُ، وَاسْتَاصِلْ مَنْ جَحَدَ حَقَّهٗ، وَاَنْكَرَ صِدْقَهٗ، وَاسْتَهَانَ بِاَمْرِهٖ، وَاَرَادَ اِخْمَادَ ذِكْرَهِ، وَسَعٰی فِیْ اِطْفَائِ نُوْرِهٖ۔ and dominate him over all the enemies of your religion, destroy all the adamant tyrants through him, and extinguish all the blazing fire through his sword, and establish his order everywhere, and create all the kingdom under his dominion, destroy the idol worshippers through him, and honour the people of qur’an and the faithful, and succeed him over all the religions, and make his enemies helpless, and humiliate whoever targets him, and overpower all those who deny his right, reject his truth, weaken his affair, wishes to destroy his memory, and strives to put off his light. اَللّٰھُمَّ نُوِّرْ بِنُوْرِهٖ كُلِّ ظُلْمَۃٍ، وَاكْشِفْ بِهٖ كُلَّ غُمَّۃٍ، وَقَدِّمْ اَمَامَهَ الرُّعْبَ، وَثَبِّتْ بِهِ الْقَلْبَ، وَاَقِمْ بِهٖ نُصْرَۃَ الْحَرْبِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ الْقَائِمَ الْمُؤَمَّلَ، وَالْوَاصِیَّ الْمُفَضَّلَ، وَالْاِمَامَ الْمُنْتَظَرَ، وَالْعَدْلَ الْمُخْتَبَرَ، وَامْلَا بِهِ الْاَرْضَ عَدْلًا وَقِسْطًا، كَمَا مُلِئَتْ جَوْرًا وَظُلْمًا، وَاَعِنْهُ عَلٰی مَا وَلَّیْتَهٗ وَاسْتَخَلَفْتَهٗ وَاسْتَرْ عَیْتَهٗ، حَتّٰی یَجْرِیَ حُكْمُهٗ عَلٰی كُلِّ حُكْمٍ، وَیَهْدِیَ بِحَقِّهٖ كُلَّ ضَلَالَۃٍ وَاحْرُسْهُ۔ o allah! brighten all the darkness through his light, and disperse all the sorrows through him, and send his terror ahead of him, and strengthen the heart through him, and establish the victory of battle through him, and make him the desired riser, and the best successor, and the anticipated imam, and the examined just person, and fill the earth with justice through him like it was filled with oppression and tyranny, and support him in the things concerning his guardianship, caliphate and observance, so that his order rules over all the orders, and guides with his right all the misguidance. اَللّٰھُمَّ بِعَیْنِكَ الَّتِیْ لَا تَنَامُ، وَاكْنُفْهُ بِرُكْنِكَ الَّذِیْ لَا یُرَامُ، وَاَعِزَّهُ بِعِزِّكَ الَّذِیْ لَا یُضَامُ، وَاجْعَلْنِیْ یَا اِلٰهِیْ مِنْ عَدَدِهٖ وَمَدَدِهٖ، وَاَنْصَارِهٖ وَاَعْوَانِهٖ وَاَرْكَانِهٖ وَاَشْیَاعِهٖ وَاَتْبَاعِهٖ، وَاَذِقْنِیْ طَعْمَ فَرْحَتِهٖ، وَاَلْبِسْنِیْ ثَوْبَ بَهْجَتِهٖ، وَاَحْصِرْنِیْ مَعَهُ لِبَیْعَتِهٖ، وَتَاكِیْدِ عَقْدِهٖ بَیْنَ الرُّكْنِ وَالْمَقَامِ عِنْدَ بَیْتِكَ الْحَرَامِ۔ o allah! safeguard him with your eye that doesn’t sleep, and supervise him under your firm supervision, and dignify him with your unending honour, and regard me, o lord, amongst his soldiers and his supporters, his helpers and his pillars, his followers and his devotees, and give me the taste of his happiness, and cover me with the attire of his freshness, and avail me alongside him for pledging allegiance with him, so that i can emphasise on the allegiance i have pledged with him between the rukn and the maqaam near your holy house. وَ وَفِّقْنِیْ یَا رَبِّ لِلْقِیَامِ بِطَاعَتِهٖ، وَالْمَثْوٰی فِیْ خِدْمَتِهٖ، وَالْمَكْثِ دَوْلَتِهٖ، وَاجْتِنَابِ مَعْصِیَتِهٖ، فَاِنْ تَوَفَّیْتَنِیْ اَللّٰھُمَّ قَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ، فَاجْعَلْنِیْ یَا رَبِّ فِیْ مَنْ یَكِرُّ فِیْ رَجْعَتِهٖ، وَیَمْلِكُ فِیْ دَوْلَتِهٖ، وَیَتَمَكَّنُ فِیْ اَیَّامِهٖ، وَیَسْتَظِلُّ تَحْتَ اَعْلَامِهٖ، وَیُحْشَرُ فِیْ زُمْرَتِهٖ، وَتَقَرُّ عَیْنُۃٗ بِرُؤْیَتِهٖ، بِفَضْلِكَ وَاِحْسَانِكَ، وَكَرَمِكَ وَامْتِنَانِكَ، اِنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِیْمِ، وَالْمَنِّ الْقَدِیْمِ، وَالْاِحْسَانِ الْكَرِیْمِ۔ o lord, succeed me for the establishment of your obedience, and for seeking shelter in his service, and for staying in his kingdom, and for distancing from sins, thus if you put me to death before the establishment of his kingdom, then regard me, o lord, amongst those who will return at the time of return, who will become the rulers, and will become powerful in his days, and will gather under his flag, and will be raised alongside him, and they eyes will be calmed by his sight, with your grace and your favour, your kindness and your generosity, indeed you are the gracious, the great, the eternal benevolent, the mighty, the beneficent. allahumma swalle alaa muhammadiw wa aale muhammadin اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔ allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon mohammed and his holy progeny. parwardigaar tu rehmat naazil farma hazrat muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki aal (a.s) par. اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔ then offer 12 units of prayer (six prayers of 2 units each) wherever you may be and in each unit after <surah fateha> recite whichever surah you wish and send its reward to his holiness (a). after offering the salaam of each 2 unit prayer, recite the tasbeeh of lady fatima zahra (s), then say… phir 12 rakat namaz 2x2 kar ke namaz-e-subh ki tarah padhe aur hazrat baqiyyatullah al-aazam ki khidmat mein hadiya kare aur jab yeh 2 rakat namaz padh rahe ho to har 2 rakat namaz ke baad tasbeeh-e-zahra (s) padhe aur yeh dua bhi padhe… پھر ۱۲ رکعت نماز دو دو کر کے نماز صبح کی طرح پڑھے اور حضرت بقیۃ اللہ ارواحنا فداہ کی خدمت میں ہدیہ کریں اور جب یہ ۲ رکعت نماز پڑھ رہے ہوں تو ہر ۲ رکعت کے بعد تسبیح زہراؑ پڑھیں اور یہ دُعا بھی پڑھیں۔۔۔ اَللّٰھُمَّ اَنْتَ اَلسَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، وَاِلَیْكَ یَعُوْدُ السَّلَامُ، حَیِّنَا رَبَّنَا مِنْكَ بِالسَّلَامِ۔ اَللّٰھُمَّ اِنَّ هٰذِهِ الرَّكَعَاتِ هَدِیَّۃٌ مِنِّیْ اِلٰی وَلِیِّكَ وَابْنِ وَلِیِّكَ وَابْنِ اَوْلِیَائِكَ، اَلْاِمَامِ بْنِ الْاَئِمَّۃِ، اَلْخَلَفِ الْصَالِحِ، اَلْحُجَّۃِ صَاحِبِ الزَّمَانِ، فَصَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدً وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَبَلِّغْهُ اِیَّاهَا، وَاَعْطِنِیْ اَفْضَلَ اَمَلِیْ وَرَجَائِیْ فِیْكَ وَفِیْ رَسُوْلِكَ، صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَیْهِ وَعَلٰی اٰلِهٖ اَجْمَعِیْنَ وَفِیْهِ۔ o allah! you are peace and from you is peace, and towards you returns peace, and gift us, o lord, with peace from you. o allah! these units are a gift from me to your guardian, and the son of your guardian and the son of your friends, the imam son of the imams, the rightful successor, the proof, the master of time; bless mohammad and his holy progeny, and deliver these prayers to him, and grant me with the best of my desire and hope in you and in your prophet and in him, your peace and blessing be upon him and his entire progeny. sayyid bin taoos says: after offering the prayer, recite the famous supplication which is recite in the period of occultation of his holiness (a). sayed ali bin tawoos farmate hai keh namaz ke baad maaroof dua jo ghaibat imam-e-asr (a) ke dauraan padhi jaati hai usko padhe. سید علی بن طاؤوس فرماتے ہیں: نماز کے بعد معروف دُعا جو غیبتِ امامِ عصرؑ کے دوران پڑھی جاتی ہے اس کو پڑھیں۔

4th ziyarat of sardaab 4th ziyarat-e-sardaab زیارت سرداب-۴ sayyid ibn e taoos says: we have mentioned the etiquettes of seeking the permission to enter in the beggin of the ziyarat of his holiness; therefore, we do not find it necessary to repeat it alongside all the ziyarats. after seeking the permission to enter, when you reach near the holy vault, say… jaleel-ul-qadr sayed ali bin tawoos farmate hai guzishta ziyarat mein hazrat baqiyyatullah al-aazam ki ziyarat ke liye izne dukhul ka tazkira kiya hai, lehaaza digar ziyarato’n ke shuru mein usey padhte rahe aur yahan ham uski takraar nahi karte hai, is muqaddas maqaam ke liye dusri ziyarat is tarah se hai keh jab izne dukhul padh le to phir is tarah se kahe… جلیل القدر سید علی بن طاؤوس فرماتے ہیں گذشتہ زیارت میں حضرت بقیۃ اللہ ارواحنا فداہ کی زیارت کے لئے اذن دخول کا تذکرہ کیا ہے، لہٰذا دیگر زیارتوں کے شروع میں اسے تکرار کرنے سے گریز کرتے ہیں یہاں اس مقدس مقام کے لئے دوسری زیارت حاضر خدمت ہے۔ جب اذن دخول کے بعد اس مقدس مقام پر وارد ہوں تو کہیں۔۔۔ bismillaahir rahmaanir raheem بِسْمِ اللہِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِیْمِ in the name of allah, the most gracious, the most merciful. (shuru karta hu) allah ke naam se jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai. اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔ insha-allah coming soon اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا خَلِیْفَۃَ اللهِ فِیْ اَرْضِهٖ، وَخَلِیْفَۃَ رَسُوْلِهٖ، وَآبَائِهِ الْاَئِمَّۃِ الْمَعْصُوْمِیْنَ الْمَهْدِیِّیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا حَافِظَ اَسْرَارِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا وَارِثَ عِلْمِ الْمُرْسَلِیْن۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا بَقِیَّۃَ اللهِ مِنَ الصَّفْوَۃِ الْمُنْتَجِبِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْاَنْوَارِ الزَّاهِرَۃِ۔ peace be upon you, o vicegerent of allah, and vicegerent of all your guided fathers. peace be upon you, o successor of the past successors (of the prophets), peace be upon you, o keeper of the secrets of the lord of the worlds. peace be upon you, o allah’s remainded from among the elite, selected ones. peace be upon you, o son of the luminous lights. insha-allah coming soon انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الْاَشْبَاحِ الْبَاهِرَۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ الصُّوْرِ النَّیِّرَۃِ الطَّاهِرَۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا وَارِثَ كَنْزِ الْعُلُوْمِ الْاِلٰهِیَّۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا حَافِظَ مَكْنُوْنِ الْاَسْرَارِ الرَّبَّانِیَّۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا مَنْ خَضَعَتْ لَهُ الْاَنْوَارُ الْمَجْدِیَّۃُ۔ peace be upon you, o son of the splendid signs. peace be upon you, o son of the immaculate progeny. peace be upon you, o essence of the prophetic knowledge. peace be upon you, o allah’s gate, the only gate from which one can enter to him. peace be upon you, o allah’s path, that perdition will be the result of anyone who takes other than it. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا بَابَ اللهِ الَّذِیْ لَا یُؤْتٰی اِلَّا مِنْهُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا سَبِیْلَ اللهِ الَّذِیْ مَنْ سَلَكَ غَیْرَهٗ هَلَكَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا حِجَابَ اللهِ الْاَزَلِیِّ الْقَدِیْمِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ شَجَرَۃِ طُوْبٰی وَسِدْرَۃِ الْمُنْتَهٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا نُوْرَ اللهِ الَّذِیْ لَا یُطْفَأُ۔ peace be upon you, o allah’s eternal and everlasting veil. peace be upon you, o observer of the tree of bliss (tuba) and the farthest lot-tree. peace be upon you, o allah’s light that never extinguishes. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا حُجَّۃَ اللهِ الَّتِیْ لَا تُخْفٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا لِسَانَ اللهِ الْمُعَبِّرُ عَنْهُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا وَجْهَ اللهِ الْمُتَقَلِّبَ بَیْنَ اَظْهُرِ عِبَادِهٖ، سَلَامَ مَنْ عَرَفَكَ بِمَا تَعَرَّفْتَ بِهٖ اِلَیْهِ، وَنَعَتَكَ بِبَعْضِ نُعُوْتِكَ الَّتِیْ اَنْتَ اَهْلُهَا وَفَوْقُهَا۔ peace be upon you, o allah’s decisive argument that is never hidden. peace be upon you, o allah’s speaking tongue which states his intentions. peace be upon you, o allah’s face that has shifted between the backs of his servants, a salutation of one who recognizes you as exactly as allah has introduced you and one who mentions only some of your characteristics that you are worthy of and even more. اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ الْحُجَّۃُ عَلٰی مَنْ مَضٰی وَ مَنْ بَقِیَ، وَاَنَّ حِزْبَكَ هُمُ الْغَالِبُوْنَ، وَاَوْلِیَائَكَ هُمُ الْفَائِزُوْنَ۔ وَاَعْدَائِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُوْنَ، وَاَنَّكَ حَائِزُ كُلِّ عِلْمٍ، وَفَاتِقُ كُلِّ رَتْقٍ، وَسَابِقٌ، لَا یُلْحَقُ۔ i bear witness that you are the argument against the past and the coming generations, your party are the true triumphant, your friends are the true winner, your enemies are the true losers, you are the keeper of the entire knowledge, you are the opener of all the closed things, you are the establisher of all truths, and you are the eradicator of all wrong things. رَضِیْتُ بِكَ یَا مَوْلَایَ اِمَامًا وَهَادِیًا، لَا اَبْتَغِیْ بَدَلًا، وَلَا اَتَّخِذُ مِنْ دُوْنِكَ وَلِیًّا، وَاَنَّكَ الْحَقُّ الثَّابِتُ، اَلَّذِیْ لَا اَعْتَابُ وَلَا اَرْتَابُ لِاَمَدِ الْغَیْبَۃِ، وَلَا اَتَحَیَّرُ لِطُوْلِ الْمُدَّۃِ۔ o my master, i accept you as my leader, guide, master, and adviser. i never seek any alternative and i never betake myself any master save you. i bear witness that you are verily the unchanging truth that is free of any defect and that allah’s promise concerning you is true, and that i never doubt no matter how long the occultation will take and the time (of your advent) will be far, and i will never have misgivings like those who ignore you and ignore the truth that you represent, and i am waiting and expecting your age, for you are the unmatched intercessor and the irrefutable master. وَعْدُ اللهِ بِكَ حَقٌّ، وَنُصْرَتُهٗ لِدِیْنِهٖ بِكَ صِدْقٌ، طُوْبٰی لِمَنْ سَعِدَ بِوَلَایَتِكَ، وَ وَیْلٌ لِّمَنْ شَقِیَ بِجُوُدِكَ، وَاَنْتَ الشَّافِعُ الْمُطَاعُ الَّذِیْ لَا یُدَافَعُ، ذَخَرَكَ اللهُ سُبْحَانَهٗ لِنُصْرَهِ الدِّیْنِ، وَاِعْزَازِ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ، وَالْاِنْتِقَامِ مِنَ الْجَاحِدِیْنَ۔ allah has saved you for the support of the religion, for the fortification of the believers, and for retaliating upon the deniers and the apostates. i bear witness that through the loyalty to you, deeds are approved, acts are purified, rewards are doubled, and punishments for wrongdoings are erased. اَلْاَعْمَالُ مَوْقُوْفَۃٌ عَلٰی وِلَایَتِكَ، وَالْاَقْوَالُ مُعْتَبَرَۃٌ بِاِمَامَتِكَ، مَنْ جَائَ بِوِلَا یَتِكَ وَاعْتَرَفَ بِاِمَامَتِكَ قَبِلَتْ اَعْمَالُهٗ، وَصُدَّقَتْ اَقْوَالُهٗ، تُضَاعَفُ لَهُ الْحَسَنَاتُ، وَتُمْحٰی عَنْهُ السَّیِّئَاتُ، وَمَنْ زَلَّ عَنْ مَعْرِفَتِكَ، وَاسْتَبْدَلَ بِكَ غَیْرَكَ، اَكَبَّهُ اللهُ عَلٰی مِنْ خَزِیْهِ فِی النَّارِ، وَلَمْ یَقْبَلْ لَهٗ عَمَلًا، وَلَمْ یُقِمْ لَهٗ یَوْمَ الْقِیَامَۃِ وَزْنًا۔ therefore, he who bears loyalty to you are recognizes your imamate will have his deeds approved, his sayings credited, his rewards doubled, and his wrongdoings erased; while if he rejects loyalty to you, ignores the recognition of you, and follows anyone else, allah shall throw him down in hellfire on the nose, shall never approve of any of his acts, and shall never set up a balance for him on the day of resurrection. اَشْهَدُ یَا مَوْلَایَ اَنَّ مَقَالِیْ ظَاهِرُهٗ كَمَاطِنِهٖ۔ وَسِرُّهٗ كَعَلَانِیَتِهٖ، وَاَنْتَ الشَّاهِدُ عَلَیَّ بِذَالِكَ، وَهُوَ عَهْدِ اِلَیْكَ، وَمِیْثَاقِی الْمَوْهُوْدُ لَدَیْكَ، اِذْ اَنْتَ نِظَامُ الدِّیْنِ، وَعِزٌّ الْمُوَحَّدِیْنَ، وَیَعْسُوْبُ الْمُتَّقِیْنَ، وَبِذَالِكَ اَمَرَنِیْ فِیْكَ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِیْنَ۔ i ask allah and his angels and you, my master, to testify to this for me the outward of this declaration is as same as its inward, and its secret is as same as its overtness; and you are the witness on this declaration, and this is my pledge to you since you are verily the system of the religion, the leader of the pious ones, and the dignity of the monotheists. فَلَوْ تَطَاوَلَتِ الدُّهُوْرُ، وَتَمَادَتِ الْاَعْصَارُ، لَمْ اَزْدَدْ بِكَ اِلَّا یَقِیْنًا، وَلَكَ اِلَّا حُبًّا، وَعَلَیْكَ اِلَّا اعْتِمَادًا، وِلَظُهُوْرِكَ اِلَّا مُرَابَطَۃً، بِنَفْسِیْ وَمَالِیْ وَجَمِیْعَ مَا اَنْعَمَ بِهٖ عَلَیَّ رَبِّیْ۔ this is the command of the lord of the worlds to me. even if times take longer periods and ages extend, this will increase in me nothing but more belief in you, love for you, reliance on and trust in you, anticipation and expectation of your advent, and waiting to strive hard in your presence. فَاِنْ اَدْرَكْتُ اَیَّامَكَ الزَّاهِرَۃَ، وَاَعْلَامَكَ الْقَاهِرَۃَ، فَعَبْدٌ مِنْ عَبِیْدِكَ، مَعْتَرِفٌ بِاَمْرِكَ وَنَهْیِكَ، اَرْجُوْ بِطَاعَتِكَ الشَّهَادَۃَ بَیْنَ یَدَیْكَ، وَبِوِلَایَتِكَ السَّعَادَۃَ فِیْ مَا لَدَیْكَ، وَاِنْ اَدْرَكْنِی الْمَوْتُ قَبْلَ ظُهُوْرِكَ، فَاَتُوَسَّلُ بِكَ اِلَی اللهِ سُبْحَانَهٗ اَنْ یُصَلِّیَ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَاَنْ یَجْعَلَ لِیْ كَرَّۃً فِیْ ظُهُوْرِكَ، وَرَجْعَۃً فِیْ اَیَّامِكَ، لِاَبْلُغَ مِنْ ظَاعَتِكَ مُرَادِیْ وَاَشْفِیَ مِنْ اَعْدَائِكَ فُؤَادِیْ۔ so, i sacrifice myself, my fortune, my sons, my family members, and all that which my lord has granted me for your sake and for obeying your orders and refraining from that which you order me not to do. o my master, if i catch your thriving days and see your splendid signs, then i, your servant, am yielding to your orders and abstaining from that which you order me not to do. through all that, i hope for martyrdom in your presence and success in your view. یَا مَوْلَایَ وَقَفْتُ فِیْ زِیَارَتِیْ اِیَّاكَ مَوْقِفَ الْخَاطِئِیْنَ الْمُسْتَغْفِرِیْنَ النَّادِمِیْنَ، اَقُوْلُ عَمِلْتُ سُوْئًا، وَظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِیْ، وَعَلٰی شَفَاعَتِكَ یَا مُوْلَایَ مُتَّكَلِیْ وَمُعَوَّلِیْ، وَاَنْتَ رُكْنِیْ وَثِقَتِیْ، وَ وَسِیْلَتِیْ اِلٰی رَبِّیْ، وَحَسْبِیْ بِكَ وَلِیًّا وَّمَوْلٰی وَشَفِیْعًا۔ o my master, but if death comes upon me before your advent, then i beseech you and your immaculate fathers to mediate for me before allah the all-exalted. whom i pray to send blessing upon mohammad and the household of mohammad and to decide for me a return after your advent and a second life during your days so that i will attain obedience to you, which is my desire, and to heal my heart from your enemies. وَالْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِیْ هُدَانِیْ لِوِلَایَتِكَ وَمَا كُنْتُ لِاَهْتَدِیَ لَوْ لَا اَنْ هَدَانِیَ اللهُ، حَمْدًا یَقْتَضِیْ ثَبَاتَ النِّعْمَۃِ، وَشُكْرًا یُوْجِبُ الْمَزِیْدَ مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ، وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا مَوْلَایَ وَعَلٰی آبَائِكَ مَوَالِیَّ الْاَئِمَّۃِ الْمُهْتَدِیْنَ وَرَحْمَۃُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهٗ، وَعَلَیَّ مِنْكُ السَّلَامُ۔ o my master, while i am visiting you, i am standing in the position of the repentant wrongdoers, i say that i have committed bad deeds, and have oppressed myself, and all my trust and reliance is on your intercession, o my master, you are my pillar and my authority, and my means towards my lord, and you are sufficient for me as a guardian and master and intercessor, and all praise be to allah who guided me towards your guardianship and i wouldn’t be guided if allah wouldn’t have guided me, a praise that causes the establishment of bounties, and a gratification that cause increment in his grace, and peace be upon you o my master and on your fathers, my masters, the guided imams, and allah’s mercy and benedictions be upon you, and peace be upon me from you. allahumma swalle alaa muhammadiw wa aale muhammadin اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔ allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon mohammed and his holy progeny. parwardigaar tu rehmat naazil farma hazrat muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki aal (a.s) par. اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔ offer 12 rakat namaz ziyarat in the form of 2 rakat like namaz fajr. after each 2 rakat recite tasbeeh zahra (s) and gift it’s reward to imam zamana (a) and the say… 12 rakat namaz ziyarat, 2x2 rakat kar ke namaz fajr ki tarah anjaam de. har 2 rakat ke baad tasbeeh zahra (s) padh kar imam zamana (a) ko hadiya kare aur phir kahe… اس کے بعد ۱۲ رکعت نماز زیارت دو دو کر کے بجا لائے، ہر ۲ رکعت کا سلام پڑھ کر تسبیح بی بی فاطمہؑ پڑھے اور اس عمل کو امام زمانہؑ کے لئے ہدیہ کرے، نماز سے فارغ ہوکر یہ پڑھے۔۔۔ bismillaahir rahmaanir raheem بِسْمِ اللہِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِیْمِ in the name of allah, the most gracious, the most merciful. (shuru karta hu) allah ke naam se jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai. اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔ اَللّٰھُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاَهْلِ بَیْتِهِ الْهَادِیْنَ الْمَهْفِیّیْنَ، اَلْعُلَمَائِ الصَّادِقِیْنَ، اَلْاَوْصِیَائِ الْمَرْضِیِّیْنَ، دَعَائِمِ دِیْنِكَ، وَاَرْكَانِ تَوْحِیْدِكَ، وَتَرَاجِمَۃِ وَحْیِكَ، وَحُجُجِكَ عَلٰی خَلْقِكَ، وَخُلَفَائِكَ فِیْ اَرْضِكَ، فَهُمُ الَّذِیْنَ اَخْتَرْتَهُمْ لِنَفْسِكَ، وَاصْطَفَیْتَهُمْ عَلٰی عِبَادِكَ، وَارْتَضَیْتَهُمْ لِدِیْنِكَ، وَخَصَصْتَهُمْ بِمَعْرِفَتِكَ، وَجَلَّلْتَهُمْ بِكَرَامَتِكَ، وَغَدَّیْتَهُمْ بِحِكْمَتِكَ، وَغَشَّیْتَهُمْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ، وَذَیَّنْتَهُمْ بِنِعْمَتِكَ، وَالْبَسْتَهُمْ مِنْ نُوْرِكَ، وَرَفَعْتَهُمْ فِیْ مَلَكُوْتِكَ، وَحَفَفْتَهُمْ بِمَلَائِكِكَ، وَشَرَّفْتَهُمْ بِنَبِیِّكَ۔ o allah, send your blessing upon mohammad and his household, the guides and the guided ones, the knowers and the truthful, the successors and the pleased ones, the pillars of your religion, the foundations of your oneness, the elucidators of your revelation, your arguments against your creation, and your vicegerents on your earth, thus they are the ones you have selected for yourself, and have chosen above your servants, and appointed them for your religion, and made the exclusive for your cognition, and glorified them with your honor, and fed them with your wisdom, and covered them with your mercy, and adorned them with your bounties, and donned them by your light, and elevated them in your loft kingdom, and surrounded them with your angels, and honoured them with your prophet. اَللّٰھُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلَیْهِمْ صَلَاۃً زَاكِیَۃً نَامِیَۃً كَثِیْرَۃً، طَیِّبَۃً دَائِمَۃً لَا یُحِیْطُ بِهَا اِلَّا اَنْتَ، وَلَا یَسَعُهَا اِلَّا عِلْمُكَ، وَلَا یُحْصِیْهَا اَحْدٌ غَیْرُكَ۔ o allah! send blessing upon mohammad and upon them, a pure, excessive and abundant blessing, a purified and eternal blessing that can be comprehended by none save you, and that can be overcome by none save your knowledge, and that can be counted by none except you. اَللّٰھُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی وَلِیِّكَ الْمُحْیِ السَّبِیْلِ، اَلْقَائِمِ بِاَمْرِكَ، اَلدَّاعِیْ اِلَیْكَ، اَلدَّلِیْلِ عَلَیْكَ، وَحُجَّتِكَ عَلٰی خَلْقِكَ، وَخَلِیْفَتِكَ فِیْ اَرْضِكَ، وَشَاهِدِكَ عَلٰی عِبَادِكَ۔ اَللّٰھُمَّ اَعِزَّ نَصْرَهٗ، وَامْدُدْ فِیْ عُمْرِهٖ، وَزَیِّنِ الْاَرْضَ بِطُوْلِ بَقَائِهٖ۔ o allah! send blessing upon your guardian, the reviver of the path, who will rise by your command, and invite towards you, the proof upon you, your argument against your creation, your vicegerent on your earth, and your witness upon your servants. o allah, strengthen his support, and extend his age, and adorn the earth with his elongated life. اَللّٰھُمَّ اكْفِهٖ بَغْیَ الْحَاسِدِیْنَ، وَاَعِذْهُ مِنْشَرِّ الْكَائِدِیْنَ، وَازْجُرْ عَنْهُ اِرَادَۃَ الظَّالِمِیْنَ، وَخَلِّصْهُ مِنْ اَیْدِی الْجَبَّارِیْنَ۔ اَللّٰھُمَّ اَعْطِهٖ فِیْ نَفْسِهٖ وَذُرِّیَّتِهٖ، وَشِیْعَتِهٖ وَرَعِیَّتِهٖ، وَخَاصَّتِهٖ وَعَامَّتِهٖ وَجَمِیْعِ اَهْلِ الدُّنْیَا، مَا تُقِرُّ بِهٖ عَیْنَهٗ، وَتُسُرُّ بِهِ نَفْسَهٗ، وَبَلِّغْهُ اَفْضَلَ اَمَلِهٖ فِی الدُّنْیَا وَالْآخِرَۃِ، اِنَّكَ عَلٰی كُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِیْرٌ۔ o allah, suffice him from the wickedness of the jealous men, and provide him shelter from the evil of the schemers, and distance him from the bad intentions of the oppressors, and protect him from the hands of the tyrants. o allah, provide him in his own self and his lineage, and his shias and his people, and his special ones and the common ones, and all the people of the world, that which brightens his eyes, and rejoices his soul, and help him achieve his best wishes in this world and the hereafter, indeed you have power over all things. allahumma swalle alaa muhammadiw wa aale muhammadin اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔ allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon mohammed and his holy progeny. parwardigaar tu rehmat naazil farma hazrat muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki aal (a.s) par. اے معبود! after entering the mosque masjid mein daakhil hone ke baad مسجد میں تشریف لاتے تو نماز سے پہلے the reciter asks for everything he needs in this world, and will be in need of on the day of judgment. all pious religious scholars recite this dua at the time of tawaf of ka-bah. the power of this dua is that you can have your complete needs in one dua… is dua ko padhne waala har woh haajaat ko talab karta hai jo uski duniya aur aakherat ke liye zaroori hai. muqaddas ulma is dua ko kaabe ka tawaaf karte waqt padhte hai. is dua ki taaqat yeh hai keh is dua mein har woh haajat shaamil hai jo padhne waale ki zaroorat hai… bismillaahir rahmaanir raheem بِسْمِ اللہِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِیْمِ in the name of allah, the most gracious, the most merciful. (shuru karta hu) allah ke naam se jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai. اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔ ilaa-hee be-akhas-se sefaate-ka wa be i’zze jalaale-ka wa a’zame asmaa-e-ka wa be-i’smate ambiyaa-e-ka wa be-noore awleyaa-e-ka wa be-dame shohadaa-e-ka wa be-medaade o’lamaa-e-ka wa be-doaa’-e solahaa-e-ka wa be-monaa-jaate foqraa-e-ka nas-aloka zeyaa-datan fil i’lme wa seha-tan fil jisme wa toolan fil u’mre fee taa-a’tek wa se-a’tan fir rizqe wa taw-batan qablal mawta wa raa-hatan i’ndal mawta wa magh-fera-tan ba’dal mawta wa nooran fil qabre wa najaa-tan menan naare wa dokhoo-lan fil jannate wa aa’fe-yatim min kulle balaa-id dunyaa wa a’zaa-bil aa-khe-rat be-haqqe mohammadin wa ahle baiyte-hit tayye-bee-nat taahe-ree-nal ma’soo-meena. اِلٰهِیْ بِاَخَصِّ صِفَاتِكَ وَبِعَزِّ جَلَالِكَ وَاَعْظَمِ اَسْمَائِكَ وَبِعِصْمَۃِ اَنْۢبَیَائِكَ وَبِنُوْرِ اَوْلِیَائِكَ وَبِدَمِ شُهَدَائِكَ وَبِمِدَادِ عُلَمَائِكَ وَبِدُعَائِ صُلَحَائِكَ وَبِمُنَاجَاۃِ فُقَرَائِكَ نَسْاَلُكَ زِیَادَۃً فِی الْعِلْمِ وَصِحَۃً فِیْ الْجِسْمِ وَطُوْلًا فِی الْعُمْرِ فِیْ طَاعَتِكْ وَسِعَۃً فِیْ الرِّزْقِ وَتَوْبَۃً قَبْلَ الْمَوْتَ وَرَاحَۃً عِنْدَ الْمَوْتَ وَمَغْفِرَۃً بَعْدَ الْمَوْتَ وَنُوْرًا فِی الْقَبْرِ وَنَجَاۃٍ مِنَ النَّارِ وَدُخُوْلًا فِی الْجَنَّۃِ وَعَافِیَۃٍ مِّنْ كُلِّ بَلَائِ الدُّنْیَا وَعَذَابِ الْآخِرَۃْ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاَهْلِ بَیْتِهِ الطَّیِّبِیْنَ الطَّاهِرِیْنَ الْمَعْصُوْمِیْنَ۔ o allah, (please do) send blessings to muhammad and the household of muhammad, allah, in the name of your most special, in the name of the dignity of your exalted majesty, in the name of the greatness of your names, in the name of the purity of your prophets, in the name of the light of your chosen representatives, in the name of the blood shed by the martyrs in your cause, in the name of the ink used by the scholars of your purpose and plan, in the name of the prayers of the righteous and in the name of the invocations made by your servants leaving in resignation and asceticism,we beseech you for continuous addition in knowledge, freedom from sickness in the body, long duration of life spent in your obedience abundance in the means of livelihood, divine guidance to turn repentant unto you, before death, freedom from pain at the time of death, protection after death, light in the grave, escape from the hell, entry into the paradise and safety from all the evils of the world and from the chastisement in the hereafter, in the name and for the sake of muhammad and his pure, purified and infallible progeny. insha-allah coming soon انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے allahumma swalle alaa muhammadiw wa aale muhammadin اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔ allah’s (s.w.t) how to greet i.mahdi (a)-1 i.mahdi (a) ko kaise salaam kare-1 امام عصر (عج) کو سلام کرنے کا طریقہ۔۱ imam baqir (a) is reported to have said: whoever from you shias stays alive and visits mahdi (a), he should say upon seeing him… imam baqir (a) frmate hai keh tum mein se jo bhi hamare qaaem-ahle-baiyt ki ziyarat kare to jab un par nazar padhe to is tarah arz kare… امام باقرؑ فرماتے ہیں: تم میں سے جو بھی ہمارے قائم اہل بیت کی زیارت کرے تو جب ان پر نظر پڑے تو اس طرح عرض کرے۔۔۔ bismillaahir rahmaanir raheem بِسْمِ اللہِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِیْمِ in the name of allah, the most gracious, the most merciful. (shuru karta hu) allah ke naam se jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai. اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔ as-salaamo a’laiy-kum yaa ahlil-baiy-tin nabuwwate wa ma’danal i’lme wa mawze-a’r resaa-late. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمْ یَا اَهْلَ الْبَیْتِ النُّبُوَّۃِ وَمَعْدَنَ الْعِلْمِ وَمَوْضِعَ الرِّسَالَۃِ۔ peace be upon you o household of prophet and the source of knowledge and position of divine messenger-hood. insha-allah coming soon انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے allahumma swalle alaa muhammadiw wa aale muhammadin اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔ allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon mohammed and his holy progeny. parwardigaar tu rehmat naazil farma hazrat muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki aal (a.s) par. اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔

special deputies ziyarat nawaab-e-arba ki ziyarat نواب اربعہ کی زیارت ziyarat of special deputies of imam mahdi's (a). hazrat imam-e-asr (a) ke nawab-e-arba ki ziyarat aur dua. امام عصر (عج) کے نواب اربعہ کی زیارت کچھ دُعائیں اور جن کو آنحضرت (عج) کے اصحاب نے نقل کیا ہے۔ the special deputies of imam mahdi (a) during his short occultation period were four individuals, namely: ghaibat-e-sughra ke zamaane mein 4 naaeb thay jink e naam is tarah hai… غیبت صغرٰی کے زمانہ میں ۴ نائب تھے جن کے اسماء اس طرح ہیں۔۔۔ abu amr othman bin saeed bin amr amri asadi. janab abu amr usman bin saeed bin amr amri asadi. جناب ابو عمرو عثمان بن سعید بن عمرو عَمری اسدی۔ his son, abu ja far mohammad bin othman bin saeed amri. aap ke farzand janab abu jafar muhammad bin usman bin saeed amri. آپ کے فرزند جناب ابو جعفر محمد بن عثمان بن سعید عَمری۔ abul qasim husain bin rauh bin abu bahr naubakhti. abul qasim husain bin rauh bin abu bahr naubakhti. ابو القاسم حسین بن روح بن ابو بحر نوبختی۔ abul hasan ali bin mohammad samari. abul hasan ali bin muhammad samari. ابو الحسن علی بن محمد سمری۔ these great personalities are the special deputies of imam mahdi (a) during his short occultation period. all the letters and commands of his holiness (a) used to reach the shias through them and by their hands. after that period, the long occultation period arrived and no more deputies were allotted. yeh woh afraad thay jo hazrat (a) ki ghaibat ke zamaane mein hazrat (a) ke khutoot (letters) kw shiyo’n tak pohonchaane ka zariya thay aur un ki rehlat (wafat) ke baad niyaabat-e-khaas ka zamaana khatm ho gaya aur ghaibat-e-kubra shuru ho gayi. یہ وہ افراد تھے جو حضرت (عج) کی غیبت کے زمانہ میں حضرت (عج) کے خطوط کو شیعوں تک پہنچا نے کا ذریعہ تھے اور ان کی رحلت کے بعد نیابت خاصہ کا زمانہ ختم ہو گیا اور غیبت کبریٰ شروع ہو گئی۔ sheikh has mentioned in "tahzeeb" and ibn taaus in "misbaahu zza' ir" that it is recommended to offer ziyarat to him such ziyarat that was attributed to abu al-qasim al-husein bin ruh (may allah be pleased with him), you stand on the tomb of uthman bin sayeed (may allah be pleased with him) and say… shaikh toosi ne kitaab tehzeeb al-ahkaam mein aur ali bin tawoos ne misbah az-zaaer mein frmaya hai: keh hazrat ke naaebin ki janab shaikh abul qasim husin bin rauh se mansoob ziyarat ke zariye ziyarat padhi jaaye. chunaan-che usman bin saeed ki qabr ke kinaare khade ho kar kahe… شیخ طوسی نے کتاب تہذیب الاحکام میں سید علی بن طاؤوس نے مصباح الزائر میں فرمایا ہے : کہ حضرت کے نائبین کی جناب شیخ ابو القاسم حسین بن روح سے منسوب زیارت کے ذریعہ زیارت بڑھی جائے۔ چنانچہ عثمان بن سعید کے مرقد کے کنارہ کھڑے ہوں اور کہیں۔۔۔ bismillaahir rahmaanir raheem بِسْمِ اللہِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِیْمِ in the name of allah, the most gracious, the most merciful. (shuru karta hu) allah ke naam se jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai. اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔ insha-allah coming soon اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی رَسُوْلِ اللهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی اَمِیْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ عَلِیٍّ بْنِ اَبِیْ طَالِبٍ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی خَدِیْجَۃَ الْكُبْرٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی فَاطِمَۃَ الزَّهْرَائِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَی الْحَسَنِ ابْنِ عَلِیٍّ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَی الْحُسَیْنِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی عَلِیِّ بْنِ الْحُسَیْنِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ بْنِ عَلَیٍّ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔ peace be upon the messenger of allah, peace be upon the commander of the faithful, ali son of abi talib, peace be upon khadjah al-kubrah, peace be upon fatimah zahra, peace be upon al-hasan son of ali, peace be upon al-husein son of ali, peace be upon ali son of al-husein, peace be upon muhammad son of ali, peace be upon ja’far son of muhammad. insha-allah coming soon انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی مُوْسَی بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی عَلِیٍّ بْنِ مُوْسٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی عَلِیِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَی الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ الْمَهْدِیِّ صَاحِبَ الزَّمَانِ۔ peace be upon musa son of ja’far, peace be upon ali son of musa, peace be upon muhammad son of ali, peace be upon ali son of muhammad, peace be upon al-hasan son of ali, peace be upon muhammad son of al-hasan al-mahdi, the leader of the time. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا عُثْمَانَ بْنَ سَعِیْدٍ۔ اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ بَابُ الْمَوْلٰی، اَدَّیْتَ عَنْهُ وَاَدَّیْتَ اِلَیْهِ، مَا خَالَفْتَهٗ وَلَا خَالَفْتَ عَلَیْهِ، قُمْتَ خَاصًّا، وَالنْصَرَفْتَ سَابِقًا، جِئْتُكَ عَارِفًا بِالْحَقِّ الَّذِیْ اَنْتَ عَلَیْهِ، وَاَنَّكَ مَا خُنْتَ فِی التَّادِیَۃِ وَالسِّفَارَۃِ۔ peace be upon you, o uthman son of sayeed, i testify that you are the gate to my master, you receive and take issues to him, you are not in contrary with him nor with those that send you to him, you specifically stood up and has previously devoted yourself. i have come to you knowing the right you possess and testifying that you did not contravene in carrying out your duty and ambassadorship. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ مَنْ بَابٍ مَّا اَوْسَعَكَ، وَمِنْ سَفِیْرٍ مَا آمَنَكَ، وَمِنْ ثِقَۃٍ مَا اَمْكَنَكَ، اَشْهَدُ اَنَّ اللهَ اخْتَصَّكَ بِنُوْرِهٖ حَتّٰی عَایَنْتَ الشَّخْصَ، فَاَدَّیْتَ عَنْهُ وَاَدَّیْتَ اِلَیْهِ۔ peace be upon you the source of well-being whose gate is wide, and from the ambassadorship that was entrusted to you, and the trustworthiness that was empowered to you, i testify that allah has chosen you with his light till you are viewed as person, and you convey from him and to him. then you repeat the salutation to the prophet and the imam (may allah's blessing be upon them) till the salutation to the leader of the time, may allah's blessing be upon him and say the following… aur phir se paighambar (s), aimma-e-masoomeen (a) aur hazrat baqiyyatulla al-aazam ko salaam kare aur kahe… اور دوبارہ پیغمبرؐ، آئمہ معصومینؑ اور حضرت بقیۃ اللہ ارواحنا فداہ کو سلام کریں اور کہیں۔۔۔ جِئْتُكَ مُخْلِصًا بِتَوْحِیْدِ اللهِ وَمُوَالَاۃِ اَوْلِیَائِهٖ، وَالْبَرَائَۃِ، مِنْ اَعْدَائِهِمْ وَمِنَ الَّذِیْنَ خَالَفُوْكَ، یَا حُجَّۃَ الْمَوْلٰی، وَبِكَ اللّٰهُمَّ تَوَجُّهِیْ، وَبِهِمْ اِلَیْكَ تَوَسُّلِیْ۔ i sincerely came to you through the oneness of allah and allegiance to his saints, and denunciation from their enemies and those that are in contrary to you. o the proof of the master, o allah i concentrated to you, and through them i seek means towards you. allahumma swalle alaa muhammadiw wa aale muhammadin اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔ allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon mohammed and his holy progeny. parwardigaar tu rehmat naazil farma hazrat muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki aal (a.s) par. اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔ then you supplicate and tender your request before allah the most high. you can also visit the other deputies with the same ziyarat but you mention their names in the place of uthman bin sayeed. phir dua kare aur apni haajat khuda se talab kare. iske baad hazrat (a) ke digar naaebo’n ki isi tarah ziyarat kare aur jis naaeb ki ziyarat karna chahte ho to usman bin saeed ki jagah par us naaeb ka naam le. پھر دُعا کریں اور اپنی حاجت خدا سے طلب کریں۔ اس کے بعد حضرت (عج) کے دیگر بائبین کی اسی طرح زیارت کریں اور جس نائب کے عوض زیارت کرنا چاہتے ہوں تو عثمان بن سعید کی جگہ اس نائب کا نام لیں۔

الْبَابُ الْاَعْظَمُ، وَالصِّرَاطُ الْاَقْوَمُ، وَالْوَلِیُّ اَلْاَكْرَمُ۔ peace be upon you o noble servant, a well-wisher for allah, and his prophet, and his friends, one who strived seriously for ahmadiyya, and for the alavi shining stars, and for the fatimid sons, peace be upon you o light for the eyes and the hidden secret, peace be upon you o relief for the hearts, and the final desire. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا شَمْسَ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ، وَرُكْنَ الْاَشْیَاعِ الْمُنْقَطِعِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی وَلِیِّ الْاَیْتَامِ، وَعَمِیْدِ الْجَحَاجِحَۃِ الْكِرَامِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَی الْوَسِیْلَۃِ
